create_TransformerEmbeddingFrontend: create a TransformerEmbeddingFrontend with an embedding table, position encoder, and dropout probability
build_TransformerEmbeddingFrontend_no_sc: build a TransformerEmbeddingFrontend with no_scale set to True to skip embedding scaling
run_TransformerEmbeddingFrontend_forward: run the forward pass of TransformerEmbeddingFrontend on a batch of token sequences with a BatchLayout
review_TransformerFrontend_abstract: review the TransformerFrontend abstract base class and its forward method signature for custom implementations
test_TransformerEmbeddingFrontend_increm: test TransformerEmbeddingFrontend forward pass with an IncrementalStateBag for incremental decoding
